purpose: Prove a deterministic 25Delta near30d formula can be calculated from one already NAS-backed authentic SOXX ORATS sample; no predictive or economic evaluation.

formula.within_expiry: linear interpolate cMidIv at call delta +0.25 and pMidIv at put delta -0.25 using the two valid quote/IV rows whose deltas bracket each target
formula.across_expiry: linear interpolate each side IV between the nearest one expiry below and one above 30 calendar days
formula.skew: put_25delta_30d_mid_IV minus call_25delta_30d_mid_IV; IV decimal and also report vol percentage points

stop: Stop if any bracket/IV/quote invalid or no two tenors bracket30. A valid one-day number is not a factor history or model/account pass.
